sources.title: Custom Audio Electronics Freddy Fuzz 90’s | Reverb
sources.excerpt: A Reverb listing identifies a rare Custom Audio Electronics Freddy Fuzz and describes it as a compact boutique fuzz with gain and volume controls. The listing says the pedal uses a sturdy metal chassis, true bypass, an LED indicator, and standard input and output jacks. The model is attributed to Custom Audio Electronics and is identified as a 1990s-era unit in the listing.
